messages:
Carla Nguyen: ok team — we need a concrete rollout plan for the 'regional routing improvements' work that balances safety, customer opt-ins, and experiments. my proposal: phased regional rollout + feature-flag cohorts + a short A/B quality test before full enable. thoughts?
Mike O'Leary: +1 on phased. can we call out exact percentages and the rollback gates? also need an SLO impact checklist for infra before we start. @Carla
Sanjay Patel: suggest phases: canary 1% (10k reqs/day), ramp 10% (100k), ramp 50%, full. rollback/gates: >2x error-rate or p95 latency increase >200ms sustained for 5m -> auto-fail to previous model. quality regression: drop in CTR/LLR on control prompts >3% -> pause.
Ruth Chen: for enterprise customers who requested isolation, we should offer an opt-in flag that pins traffic to dedicated capacity. they get canary opt-in per-tenant. also need exportable audit for who flipped flags.
Carla Nguyen: good points. here's a minimal flag config we can put in the flag service (example):
```yaml
flag: regional_routing_v2
cohorts:
  - name: canary
    pct: 1
    regions: [us-east-1]
  - name: early_ramp
    pct: 10
    regions: [us-east-1, eu-west-1]
  - name: open
    pct: 50
    regions: all
kill_switch: true
default_fallback: routing_v1
enterprise_opt_in: true
telemetry_hooks: [latency_p95, error_rate, quality_delta]
```
Mike O'Leary: love the YAML. two infra notes: 1) capacity headroom must be >30% for the 10% ramp in each target region. 2) canary runs should include shadow traffic to the new path for 24h to validate correctness (no user-visible effect).
deploy-bot: canary started — regional_routing_v2 canary 1% in us-east-1 (ts=1768001245) :rocket:
Sanjay Patel: A/B test: for the first 10% cohort, split 50/50 new vs control and run a short significance window (48h) on our prompt set. Primary metrics: latency_p95, error_rate, and prompt-quality score (eval harness). If quality_delta < 1% and infra signals green -> proceed. If quality_delta between 1-3% -> hold and run targeted prompts with human-in-loop.
Ruth Chen: who signs off to move from 10% -> 50%? propose QA lead + SRE oncall + product PM. we should have a concise checklist doc: infra headroom, telemetry deck, customer opt-out list cleared.
Carla Nguyen: agree. action items: @Mike confirm capacity headroom per region by EOD; @Sanjay draft A/B test prompt set and significance thresholds; @Ruth draft the signoff checklist and include enterprise opt-in workflow. i'll own the rollout playbook and the feature-flag gating automation.
Mike O'Leary: noted. i'll add a smoke-test script to run post-ramp and a capacity-runbook with scaling thresholds. will link in channel when done.
Sanjay Patel: also recommend adding a short-lived canary tag so we can route diagnostic traces quickly: `x-canary-id: routing-v2-2026-03-21`. makes triage faster.
Carla Nguyen: nice. include trace tag and add a fallback policy: if rollback triggered, automatically route 10% of traffic to safe-fallback for 15m while we do live debugging, then either re-enable or hold.
deploy-bot: alert: canary p95 latency +30ms at ts=1768001267 — monitoring alert created in #eng-sre
Ruth Chen: seeing the alert. can we have an auto-postmortem stub created by the bot on critical auto-rollback? helps with fast blameless reviews.
Carla Nguyen: yes, enable auto-postmortem on failures that trigger rollback. final ask: any customer-facing comms needed for this rollout? enterprise PMs, please flag if we need pre-notice.
Mike O'Leary: i'll ping account leads for customers in us-east-1 with opt-in options.
Sanjay Patel: i'll instrument the eval harness to publish a short daily digest for the first week of the 10% cohort.
Carla Nguyen: great. if no blockers, i'll kick off the public playbook draft and assign reviewers. :shipit:
Ruth Chen: signoff process looks solid. thanks all. :eyes:
